sections.h2: India's SIGHT bids sit about 2.7 to 2.8 times the 2030 target

chart.sub: Hydrogen production cost, $ per kg, plant gate.

sections.h2: Electrolysers are projected to learn far more slowly than solar PV

chart.title: Electrolysers' projected 16 to 21% learning rate trails solar's 36%
chart.sub: Learning rate: % cost decline each time cumulative deployment doubles.
chart.source: Industry masterclass on green hydrogen cost reduction, as cited in the post.

sections.means: Electrolyser costs are expected to fall much more slowly per doubling of deployment than solar panel costs did, so closing the gap will take longer.

sections.h2: Waiving open-access charges is the largest policy lever at $0.48/kg

chart.sub: Reduction in hydrogen cost from each lever, $ per kg.
chart.source: CEEW and CFLI, Financing Green Hydrogen in India (2024), as cited in the post.

sections.means: Waiving open-access charges is the largest single lever in the financiers' policy-plus-market stack, ahead of electrolyser and renewable cost reductions.
